name: Apostle Atlanta
source:
Atlanta is a mage and is skilled with many curses and spells. Her most iconic curse is the one that traps her opponent in a Mirror and divides it into several fragments. Those trapped in it cannot get out and their only hope is that someone else finds all the mirror pieces. Once they are all gathered and put together, the victim will be released immediately. 

[spoiler]Atlanta is an Apostle of Lexington first (chronologically) seen in Rance IV and later seen in every iteration of the Toushin Toshi series up to date. She's travelling all over The Continent carrying the Demonic Blood Soul of her master searching for a way to bring him back, but she's not very competent, since she's spent a few centuries with no success.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Atlanta]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
